messages:
Sam (Support): Customer reported a sudden set of 402s today after we processed a chargeback/refund last night. They say promo credits vanished and balance went negative at -$14.20. Account: acct_9X7F. Customer: VectorIoT.

Sam (Support): Repro steps I ran:
```
# check balance
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXX\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/acct_9X7F/balance
# => {\"balance\": -14.20, \"available_credits\": 0.00}
# usage call returning 402s
curl -s -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXX\" -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-large\",\"prompt\":\"hello\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# => 402 Payment Required: \"insufficient credits\"
```

billing-bot: Chargeback processed: cb_20260315_451 for invoice inv_20260312_772 (amount $120.00). Related txn: txn_8a2f. Promo reversal issued: promo_reversal_331.

Jess (Eng): Thanks Sam. This looks like the classic promo-grant ordering edge case: promo applied after original invoice, then chargeback reversed earlier ledger entries and our reconciliation double-clawed the promo grant (or failed to restore it). Can you paste the ledger snippet for acct_9X7F around 2026-03-12..15?

Sam (Support): Pasted minimal ledger entries below (sanitized):
```
2026-03-12T10:21:00Z txn_charge inv_20260312_772 +120.00
2026-03-12T10:21:05Z txn_promo_grant promo_ABC +25.00
2026-03-13T08:00:12Z usage_charge usage_923 -18.42
2026-03-15T02:12:09Z txn_chargeback cb_20260315_451 -120.00
2026-03-15T02:12:09Z promo_reversal promo_reversal_331 -25.00
2026-03-15T02:15:00Z auto_reconcile adjust_clawback -0.78
```
(Notice promo_reversal happened same time as chargeback.)

Mike (CS): Customer says they used free trial flows in prod and are blocked. They want immediate unblocking or a rollback. Can support issue a temporary manual credit while engineering investigates?

Nora (Finance): We need cb id and original payment method to reconcile with payments processor before we can reverse. But we can authorize a temporary goodwill credit once engineering confirms delta. Please confirm amount to grant and the audit note.

Jess (Eng): Proposed immediate mitigation: grant a manual credit txn to fix the negative available balance so API calls no longer 402. Then follow with a backfill job to recompute account balance from the authoritative ledger (apply idempotent reduction of any double-clawback entries). Code-level note: modify reconcile_chargeback to use ledger anchoring so promo reversals are only applied if promo was granted before the chargeback event. Pseudocode: 
```
def reconcile_chargeback(account, cb_event):
    for entry in ledger.range(cb_event.time - lookback, cb_event.time + lookahead):
        if entry.type == 'promo_grant' and entry.timestamp > cb_event.timestamp:
            # promo was granted after chargeback, skip reversal
            continue
        apply_clawback(entry)
```
This will avoid removing promos granted after chargebacks.

Sam (Support): Suggested temp credit: +$25.00 to cover lost promo, plus +$15.00 buffer = $40.00. Label txn_manual_credit_manual_unblock_181234. Nora, please authorize?

Nora (Finance): Authorizing temporary one-off credit txn_manual_cc_181234 for $40.00 as goodwill. Finance will notate: \"Temp credit pending chargeback resolution cb_20260315_451; follow up for true settlement.\" Once done, reply with txn id.

billing-bot: Manual credit created: txn_manual_cc_181234 +40.00 (pending settlement).

Sam (Support): Applied and customer unblocked. They confirm API calls succeed. They asked for an ETA on a permanent fix.

Jess (Eng): Plan: 1) Hotfix to reconcile logic (PR linked), 2) Run ledger reindex/backfill job scoped to accounts with negative balances from 2026-03-10..2026-03-20, 3) Add unit/integration tests for promo/chargeback ordering, 4) Postmortem and monitoring alert for promo_reversal spikes. ETA for hotfix + deploy: ~6 hours. Backfill run needs coordination with billing indexing — ~24-36 hours.

Mike (CS): I'll update the customer: temporary credit applied, root cause under investigation, expect permanent fix within 48 hours. Will offer refund/waived charges if backfill misses anything.

Nora (Finance): After backfill, if we find we oversupported, we'll recalc and apply a deterministic adjustment and notify customer. Finance requests final ledger diff before we close the ticket.

Jess (Eng): Also adding a quick smoke test to CI that simulates: issue invoice -> grant promo -> process chargeback -> ensure promo state is correct and available_credits >= 0.

Sam (Support): Closing loop: customer satisfied for now. Ticket #SUP-4521. Will follow up once backfill completes. :thumbsup:

Jess (Eng): Thanks all. I'll post the PR and deploy notes in #eng-releases once merged.
